notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Burning Inquiry from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Burning Inquiry, causing each player to draw three cards and discard three cards at random.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
